design: SIH26009 schema-faithful synthetic demo generator v3
geology_row_meaning: synthetic assay/interval observation associated with a real MOIL mine; mine coordinates are map anchors, not claimed sample coordinates

economic_model.price: static lookup by mine + Mn grade band; official IBM ex-mine reference where available, otherwise median official-reference fallback
economic_model.cost: static mine-level production-cost lookup where available, otherwise median official-reference fallback
economic_model.warning: profit_proxy_inr is indicative gross margin only; not accounting/net profit

warnings: Do not call estimated_tonnage_proxy_t a certified reserve/resource estimate.
Do not sum synthetic observation tonnage proxies into a mine reserve/profit total until real non-overlapping spatial blocks/geometry are available.
Do not interpret synthetic satellite covariance as a manganese spectral law.
Do not interpret synthetic chemistry correlations as calibrated MOIL geology.
Dongri Buzurg production target uses a historical capacity proxy, not a same-period IBM annual plan.
Tirodi and Dongri Buzurg map points should be replaced with official lease/DGPS/KML geometry when obtained.
Replace synthetic rainfall with IMD; satellite reflectance with Sentinel-2/ASTER; and operational records with MOIL data when available.
